note: Layout Options provides a LayoutOptions layout plugin (Drupal\layout_options\Plugin\Layout\LayoutOptions, extends core LayoutDefault) and LayoutOption option plugins so YAML files ([provider].layout_options.yml, sections layout_option_definitions + layout_options) add CSS-class/id controls to layouts. LayoutOption plugin type: annotation @LayoutOption, manager plugin.manager.layout_options; built-in ids layout_options_id, layout_options_class_select, layout_options_class_radios, layout_options_class_checkboxes, layout_options_class_string. The base module has no settings form. A layout must USE the LayoutOptions plugin class for options to appear; the layout_options_ui submodule swaps existing layouts' class to it (via layout_options.settings layout_overrides + hook_layout_alter). Medium/hard cases verify the module's real effect through the core layout plugin manager: when an override is active, a core layout's class becomes LayoutOptions. (layout_options_ui must be enabled for the alter hook; it is.) Baseline layout_overrides is empty, restored explicitly.

evals.prompt: In the Layout Options module, what plugin type provides the individual option controls, and what are the built-in option plugins for adding CSS classes and an id to a layout?
evals.expected_output: Options are LayoutOption plugins (annotation @LayoutOption, manager plugin.manager.layout_options). Built-ins: layout_options_id (id attribute), layout_options_class_select, layout_options_class_radios, layout_options_class_checkboxes (CSS classes), and layout_options_class_string (free-text classes).

evals.prompt: How do you declare layout options in Layout Options without writing PHP? Name the YAML file and its two main sections.
evals.expected_output: Add a {provider}.layout_options.yml file in a module or theme. It has two sections: layout_option_definitions (each option's title, default, plugin, and layout/regions applicability) and layout_options (rules choosing which options show on which layouts: global, per layout id, or per field).

evals.prompt: For a Drupal layout to actually expose Layout Options controls, which layout plugin class must it use, and how can you make an existing core layout use it?
evals.expected_output: The layout must use the Drupal\layout_options\Plugin\Layout\LayoutOptions plugin class (it extends core LayoutDefault). To retrofit an existing core/contrib layout, use the layout_options_ui submodule, whose hook_layout_alter swaps the layout's class to LayoutOptions.

evals.prompt: On this site, inspect the core 'layout_onecol' layout via the layout plugin manager and tell me which layout plugin class it currently uses.
evals.expected_output: layout_onecol currently uses Drupal\layout_options\Plugin\Layout\LayoutOptions (instead of the core Drupal\Core\Layout\LayoutDefault), because a Layout Options override is enabled for it, so it exposes the Layout Options controls.

evals.prompt: Exactly one core layout on this site has been switched to the Layout Options plugin. Inspect the running layouts and tell me which core layout id now uses the Layout Options class.
evals.expected_output: layout_twocol: its definition's class is now Drupal\layout_options\Plugin\Layout\LayoutOptions (the other core layouts still use LayoutDefault).

evals.prompt: Make the core two-column layout (layout_twocol) use the Layout Options plugin so it gains the Layout Options styling controls, and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Enable the override for layout_twocol (via the layout_options_ui form at /admin/config/system/layout_options/config, or set layout_options.settings layout_overrides['layout_discovery__layout_twocol'] = 1) and rebuild the layout plugin cache. The core.layout plugin manager then reports layout_twocol's class as Drupal\layout_options\Plugin\Layout\LayoutOptions.

evals.prompt: Switch the core one-column layout (layout_onecol) to the Layout Options plugin class on the live site so it can expose Layout Options controls.
evals.expected_output: Enable the override for layout_onecol (layout_options.settings layout_overrides['layout_discovery__layout_onecol'] = 1, or via the layout_options_ui form) and rebuild caches. The core.layout manager then reports layout_onecol's class as Drupal\layout_options\Plugin\Layout\LayoutOptions.
